annotations.title: Show something on the call page

description: Put a card on the person's call page (never spoken): text, code, a link or an image. kind: text (default), code (monospace with copy button), link (exactly one http(s) URL, shown as a tappable link), image (`image` = SVG text or base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP, line breaks, a data:image/...;base64, prefix and missing padding are accepted; or `file_id` of an image uploaded with the REST endpoint POST /api/bridge/upload, which keeps large base64 out of the tool call). kind image REQUIRES `context`: the full text of everything in the image (numbers, table rows, labels); it is never shown, the voicebot cannot see images and answers questions from it. A new card appears as a small preview top left; panel cards opens the cards view, board, log or decisions open those panels, none closes them. large: true opens the cards view big in the middle with this card at full size (diagrams, swimlanes; implies panel cards). SVG may draw anything (no scripts, no foreignObject, no external references). Files (reports, tables): kind pdf (preview with page turning and download), csv (table preview of the first rows and download) or md (Markdown, rendered safely, and download) with `data` = the file as base64 and `name` = file name (e.g. report.pdf), or `file_id` from POST /api/bridge/upload. Limits: text 4000 chars, title 80, SVG 300 KB, raster 1024 KB, pdf 10 MB, csv and md 2 MB (UTF-8).

context.description: Required for kind image: the full text of everything in the image (numbers, table rows, labels). Invisible on the page; the voicebot reads it to answer questions about the image. Max 4000 chars.
context.title: Context

data.description: kind pdf, csv or md: the file as base64 (pdf max 10 MB, csv/md max 2 MB UTF-8).
data.title: Data

file_id.description: kind image, pdf, csv or md: id from POST /api/bridge/upload (same call, same limits and checks); instead of image or data.
file_id.title: File Id

image.description: kind image: SVG text or base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP (SVG max 300 KB, raster max 1 MB).
image.title: Image

large.description: Open the cards view big in the middle with this card at full size.
large.title: Large

name.description: kind pdf, csv or md: file name shown on the card and used for the download.
name.title: Name

text.description: Card text, max 4000 chars (code: the code; link: the URL).
text.title: Text
